plugin.name: MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize
plugin.description: Self-hosted MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize 0.9B: long-form multi-speaker transcription with timestamps and speaker labels in one pass, plus per-speaker audio tracks. 50+ languages, up to ~90 min.

env.description: Hugging Face token (the model is public and Apache-2.0; only needed if it becomes gated)
Max seconds to wait for a Modal call
Modal GPU type. The model is only 0.9B, so L4 is the right size; raise it for very long recordings
Decoder cap for one pass. Long multi-speaker audio needs headroom or the transcript stops mid-way
